Resolve runtime dependencies through Zaq.Config.get/4 and explicit opts/context. Deterministic barriers/clock/ID controls; no global Application environment mutation or cross-test PubSub leakage. Audit-only tasks need no mocks.

## Action reuse assessment

Before implementation recheck candidate @moduledoc, schemas, callers and tests, record concrete evidence and final public input/output/error/permission/retry contracts. Missing standalone Actions must be implemented in their prerequisite issue before callers. Nil identity never grants authority; cross-role BO operations use fixed Events and NodeRouter.
